claims.claim: Binance 14 sweep tx 0x53bd38b8 (block 26300770, 2026-10-29 20:24:23 UTC) moved 167,464.2478 ETH and 63 ERC-20 transfers including ~1.615B USDT to the attacker hub.
A type-4 delegation tx (block 26300753, 20:20:59 UTC) carried 50 authorizations signed with authority Binance 14; only nonce 18,914,809 took effect.
Binance says initial probe may involve a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop and found no evidence of any wallet private key leak; estimates ~$6.3B impact and ~$3B frozen.
TRM estimates gross theft ~$6.36B across ten chains (Ethereum ~$3.79B, Bitcoin ~$1.47B, Tron ~$628M) at theft-time prices.
Issuers and others froze ~$2.7B as of 00:30 UTC 2026-10-30 (Tether ~1.77B, Circle ~825M, Ripple 40.5M, WLFI 27.8M, Arbitrum Security Council ~$30M); attacker holds ~$2.4B beyond issuer reach.
TRM attributes the theft to TraderTraitor (DPRK) with high confidence; no government or Binance confirmation as of 2026-10-30.
EIP-7702 requires the authorization nonce to equal the authority's current nonce, sets code to 0xef0100||address, and delegating to the zero address resets code.
Bybit: Sygnia traced foothold on a Safe developer workstation 2025-02-04 to theft 2025-02-21 (~17 days); FBI attributed ~$1.5B theft to North Korea.
Binance SAFU fund was converted to 15,000 BTC (~$1.0B in Feb 2026) with a top-up pledge below $800M.
Chainalysis counted $2.02B stolen by DPRK-linked actors in 2025, ~59% of more than $3.4B stolen.
BNB fell 8.6% to ~$694 and liquidations reached $627.7M in an hour ($606.6M longs, $344.8M on Binance) after the incident, confounded by a same-day tech selloff.
Wintermute reported more than 90% of EIP-7702 delegations went to malicious sweeper code (The Block reported more than 80%).
